DESCRIPTION:
Run a DB schema migration

USAGE:
    Pondhawk.Migrations Up [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help            Prints help information                               
    -P, --provider        The name of the Provider (MySql, Postgres, Sqlist,    
                          SqlServer, etc.)                                      
    -C, --connection      The Db connection string                              
    -S, --scripts-path    The scripts path                                      
    -Q, --quiet           No terminal output                                    
    -T, --test            Just show discovered Options and pre run status
